title: Tender Corn Tortillas from Masa
description: Tender Corn Tortillas from Masa made from a small batch of scratch dough.

steps.title: Hydrate the masa
steps.text: Knead {masa}, warm {water} and {salt} for 2 minutes until smooth.

steps.title: Rest the dough
steps.text: Cover and rest 20 minutes; the edges should press smooth.

steps.title: Press the tortillas
steps.text: Press eight balls between reusable food-safe sheets into thin 5-inch rounds.

steps.title: Heat the surface
steps.text: Preheat the 12-inch cast iron skillet over medium-high for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Cook in batches
steps.text: Cook each tortilla in a dry warm skillet for 30 seconds, flip for 45 seconds, then flip again until small brown spots appear.

steps.title: Steam the stack
steps.text: Wrap the hot rounds in a clean towel for 5 minutes to soften.

notes: Make ahead: weigh the dry ingredients the evening before. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Cool completely and freeze sliced or individually wrapped for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: wrap a serving in a damp towel and microwave for 15–25 seconds. Freezer reheat: thaw wrapped, then warm the same way. Serve with soup or gravy for a softer bite. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 137 kcal, 3.2 g protein, 28.9 g total carbohydrate, 1.4 g fat, 2.7 g fiber, 149 mg sodium.
